caption:
If you believe you can live well on four or five hours of sleep each night, Hear me out

#sleep #wellnessjourney #sleepbetterlivebetter
transcript: If you believe you can live well on four or five hours of sleep each night, hear me gently. That path shortens life. Again and again, wisdom and science agree on this. The body heals in rest. Six to eight hours is where the body repairs itself. Seven is where most souls settle best. More than nine hours and the body grows heavy. Less than five and the body begins to break. When sleep is stolen, the heart carries the cost. The blood thickens. The organs age faster than time intended. Disease does not arrive suddenly. It whispers in exhaustion first. Do not glorify being tired. Do not worship the grind. Rest is not weakness. Sleep is not laziness. Sleep is how the body remembers how to stay alive. If this spoke to you, comment, rest below, and follow this page for more quiet truths your body already knows.
